fact: RISA's Government of Rwanda Enterprise Architecture Framework, Version 2.1, states the government chose TOGAF and customised it into the Rwanda Government-wide Enterprise Architecture Framework (RGEA) to set common architecture standards across public entities; it is a framework, not a systems inventory, and gives no date, so the published date 2026-08-06 is used.
MINECOFIN says Rwanda's IFMIS supports government budgeting, expenditure control, payments, accounting and financial reporting across public institutions.
MINECOFIN says it completed a major technological upgrade of the IFMIS, replacing legacy components that had reached end of support with new enterprise technologies.
